summary: Full E2E validation of studio Fase 1. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass covering salud, recorridos catalogue, empty studio, ajustes CRUD + persistence, espacio CRUD, proyecto creation for all 4 tipos, step-name/state validation, ubicacion save, retomar, no auto content, cleanup. Frontend Playwright E2E: empty welcome, create espacio (Cliente A/cliente), navigate to /e/:id, all 4 project types created and each recorrido bar shows the correct step names in order (corto, anuncio, imagen [Encargo de imagen at position 3, no Montaje], serie), gasto indicator only inside project ('Gasto: 0,00 $'), NOT on Apertura or Espacio, PasoMinimo has titulo-paso + aviso-fase + bloque-siguiente-paso, Retomar card appears and navigates to last visited step, Ajustes has only moneda + presupuesto (no provider fields), select-moneda change triggers 'Guardando…' → 'Guardado' and persists after reload, Identidad dialog autosave also works, Biblioteca leads to biblioteca-minima Fase 3 stub.
critical_code_review_comments: React Router v6 future-flag warnings in console (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath). Non-blocking but should be enabled to avoid future migration pain.
Selector uses a native <select> — this is acceptable per spec (light mode, no shadcn) and works with Playwright select_option; no picker/calendar issues.
Ajustes screen does not show 'Guardado' indicator immediately on mount before user edits (correct — inactivo state hides it), verified working after change.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_-prefixed espacio and 4 proyectos, then delete them in test_cleanup. Frontend E2E left a 'Cliente A' espacio with 4 proyectos in the DB (mongosh studio to clean if needed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Fase 1 features validated. Backend contract: espacios expects {nombre, tipo_espacio, descripcion?, notas_de_marca?}; proyectos expects {nombre, tipo, formato_video} where formato_video ∈ {16:9,9:16,1:1,4:5}. Recorridos are read from /app/backend/data/recorridos.yaml and are authoritative. Frontend Selector is native <select>; use page.select_option. Retomar sorts by ultimo_acceso desc which is updated on every step visit.
